title: Counting a deal's notes through its related list misses notes attached to the contact
symptoms: Note totals per deal are lower than the notes visible in the app
cause: Each note attaches to a Parent_Id, which is often the deal's Contact rather than the deal.
fix: Read the Notes module itself and match Parent_Id against both deal ids and contact ids.
apply: GET /bigin/v2/Notes with fields including Parent_Id, paging per_page=200, then group by Parent_Id.id across deals and their contacts
